profile.name: Interpump Group S.p.A.
profile.summary: Interpump Group S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and selling of high-pressure pumps in Italy, rest of Europe, North America, the Far East and the Pacific Area, and internationally. The company is involved in the design and distribution of volumetric pumps; production, sale, and distribution of pressure systems and pumps; production of mechanical sifters; production and sale of equipment for the food processing, chemicals, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals industries; galvanic treatment of metals; and sale of centrifugal separators. It also engages in drawing, shearing, and pressing sheet metal; design, production, and sale of mechanized milking systems; production and sale of power take-offs, hydraulic pumps, hydraulic cylinders, valves, rotary unions, hydraulic hoses, and fittings, as well as rubber mixtures, rigid and flexible hydraulic lines, and directional controls; sale of ancillary products for industrial vehicles; surface treatments; and smelting of ferrous metals, cast iron, and aluminum. In addition, the company is involved in the production and sale of power transmission systems, planetary gears, ratiomotors, and drive wheels; and the design, production, and sale of piping systems. Further, it offers water-jetting and hydraulics-related components, as well as flanges, oil tanks, gears, orbital motors, steering system, cylinder, mixers, plunger pumps, special pumps, cleaning systems, and valves and tanks. Interpump Group S.p.A. was founded in 1977 and is based in Sant'ilario D'enza, Italy.
profile.summary_fr: Interpump Group S.p.A., avec ses filiales, se consacre à la fabrication et à la vente de pompes haute pression en Italie, dans le reste de l'Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Extrême-Orient et dans la région du Pacifique, ainsi qu'à l'international. La société est impliquée dans la conception et la distribution de pompes volumétriques; production, vente et distribution de systèmes de pression et de pompes; production de tamis mécaniques; production et vente d'équipements pour les industries alimentaires, chimiques, cosmétiques et pharmaceutiques; traitement galvanique des métaux; et vente de séparateurs centrifuges. Elle s'occupe également du tréfilage, du cisaillage et du pressage de tôles; de la conception, de la production et de la vente de systèmes de traite mécanisés; de la production et de la vente de prises de force, de pompes hydrauliques, de vérins hydrauliques, de vannes, de raccords, de tuyaux hydrauliques, de mélanges de caoutchouc, de conduites hydrauliques rigides et flexibles et de commandes directionnelles; de la vente de produits auxiliaires pour véhicules industriels; des traitements de surface.
